author: Independent evaluation author for the Kinwise team (Claude Code acting as a clinical-pharmacist test author; not the engine author)
method: Each expectation was derived from the published criteria (AGS Beers 2023 Tables 2-7 read from the PMC full text and the journal PDF; the ACB 2012 card; CDC STEADI, STEADI-Rx and STOPPFall for fall-risk drugs; ThinkCascades and the primary cascade studies; STOPP/START v3 for duplicate classes; Budnitz 2011/2021 for the SPEC 12 monitoring classes) before and without reading the engine (src/engine/meds) or the compiled knowledge base (src/kb/data). Medication names are typed the way a family would (brands, generics, OTC combinations, dose text). See eval/MED-CASES-METHOD.md.
disclaimer: Synthetic, fictional test cases for software testing. Not patient data, not clinical validation, and not medical advice. No flag does not mean a medicine is safe.

conventions.today: All dates are relative to today = 2026-10-10. startDate = today - daysAgoStarted; endDate = today - daysAgoStopped when given, else null.
conventions.ingredients: Lowercase generic names. An expectation matches a finding when the finding's category is equal and every listed ingredient is among the ingredients of the medications the finding involves (finding.medIds -> Medication.ingredientIds). Matching is token-based so 'trimethoprim' matches 'sulfamethoxazole_trimethoprim' and 'insulin' matches 'insulin glargine'.
conventions.emptyIngredients: An empty ingredients list means 'any finding of this category' (used in mustNotInclude to say 'no finding of this category at all').
conventions.comboProducts: Assertions are at medication level. For a combination product every ingredient of that product counts as involved, so a negative assertion about one ingredient of a combination cannot be expressed; minMatches is used where one product meets two criteria.
conventions.nonVacuity: Every ingredient named in an expectation must resolve from at least one of the case's medication names via matchDrug; otherwise the expectation fails as a precondition failure (so a negative cannot pass just because a name did not resolve).
conventions.fuzzy: A 'fuzzy' match from matchDrug is treated as unconfirmed (ingredientIds = [], match = 'none') unless the case sets confirmSuggestion: true.
conventions.diary: diary.fallsLast12Months = true adds one confirmed check-in 20 days before today with fall = true (all other answers unanswered).
conventions.newVsLongTerm: Warfarin 'initial therapy' is encoded as started 10 days ago; 'long-term' as started 1200 or 2200 days ago. An engine that treats a start within the last N days as initial therapy passes for any N from 10 to 1199.
conventions.chronicNsaid: Chronic NSAID use is encoded as 120-365 days of daily use; short-term as 10 days (the only short-term NSAID that carries an assertion). An engine that treats >= N days as chronic passes for any N from 11 to 120.
conventions.ppi: PPI 'more than 8 weeks' is tested at 150 and 400 days (positive) and 21 days (negative).
